Corollary
↗ thm:bishop-gromov-volume-comparison 1. ch11:11.20

Let $(M,g)$ be a compact Riemannian $n$-manifold satisfying $\operatorname {Rc}(v,v)\geq (n-1)/R^2$ for every unit vector. Then \[ \operatorname {Vol}(M) \leq \operatorname {Vol}\bigl(S^n(R)\bigr). \] If equality holds, $(M,g)$ has constant sectional curvature $1/R^2$.
